title: Focus Visibility: Never Get Lost 🔍
description: Beyond CSS outlines: programmatic focus management, focus-visible vs focus, and styling focus for all users.

slides.title: Why Focus Visibility Matters 👁️
slides.content:
WCAG 2.4.7 (Focus Visible) requires a visible indication of focus for all keyboard‑operable UIs. Without it, keyboard users are lost.

- The default browser focus ring is often removed by developers (bad!).
- You can design a beautiful, custom focus ring that meets contrast requirements.
- Focus must be visible on **all** interactive elements, even custom ones.

The focus indicator is the 'cursor' for the keyboard – you wouldn't hide the mouse cursor, would you?

quizData.question: What is the minimum contrast ratio required for a focus indicator?
quizData.explanation: WCAG 2.4.11 (Focus Appearance) recommends at least 3:1 contrast for the focus indicator.

slides.title: `:focus` vs `:focus-visible` – Best Practice 🎨
Accessible Focus CSS

quizData.question: Which pseudo-class should you use for a custom focus ring that appears only when navigating with the keyboard?
quizData.explanation: `:focus-visible` heuristically applies when the user is likely using a keyboard.

slides.title: Programmatic Focus Management 📍
slides.content:
Sometimes you need to move focus via JavaScript:

- `element.focus()` – focuses an element (can be used on any focusable element, including those with tabindex="-1").
- `element.blur()` – removes focus.
- `document.activeElement` – returns the currently focused element.

Use cases: opening a modal (move focus inside), closing a modal (return focus), after deleting an item (move focus to next logical item).

slides.title: Focus After Deletion

quizData.question: What will `document.activeElement` return if no element is focused?
quizData.explanation: If nothing is focused, the active element defaults to the document body.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Always test with a screen reader
What looks visible may not be announced. Use VoiceOver or NVDA to verify focus changes are communicated.
